title: NB Gaming Monitor Arm for Screen up to 60 inches, Holds 44 lbs(20 kg), VESA 75/100, RGB Light, Heavy Duty Monitor Stand, Aluminum Ultrawide Screen Mount Height Angle Adjustable Grey Black
reviews: Very sturdy monitor arm! I love the color and overall look of it. It adjusts in multiple directions and holds my 34-inch curved monitor with no issues. The joints are definitely tight, but honestly that adds to the stability and keeps the monitor from drifting or sagging. Once adjusted, it stays in place really well. Definitely worth it if you want something sturdy and reliable.

So far it is as expected given it has plenty of room to grow if you change your monitors around with a quick snap feature so you can unclip it and put the mount on another without taking but a few minutes. The build quality is far better than the one I have previously been using and feels solid. The base also has a quick swap feature that you can move the notches up or down to quickly attach to a thin or really thick desk which is quite important given some you get stuck with whatever the factory default is a doesn't account for desks having things in your way. If your wondering; Yes, it will fit smaller monitors also, but be warned you will need to reduce the tension pretty much all the way down if the weight isn't very much to keep the shocks in place which is fairly easy with the long hand wrench that is included without needing 3 different sizes like some do. There are instructions but it is pretty easy to figure out if you have assembled one before since the majority of it is already done for you straight out of the box with the exception of going back behind and snugging the locks on the pivots so they stay put but are just loose enough to move the monitor stand around without force. Overall I would recommend it if you plan on using one for a long time given you can keep using the same mount for pretty much any size without worries.

Before this I tried a monitor arm that claimed to hold 3 32 inch monitors on its stand. I was having issues with that product with just two of them. This is well worth the money. I currently have two of them, one is holding a 32 in LG monitor and the other is holding a 34 in UW LG monitor. Both are completely stable, I am able to move them around any way that I see fit. The ability to pan up, down, left or right is still there and it will hold it in whatever position you are looking for. If you need to have multiple monitors in different positions, and they are good quality (meaning they will weigh 20+ lbs) this is the ideal monitor arm. I understand there are monitor arms out there that cost much less, but what you get here is something that is easy to assemble, it fits even ultra-wide monitors without any additional steps, and you have an incredible range of motion and you have a peice of mind that it wont just drop on your desk.. this is the monitor stand for you.

Works great I have my 57" Samsung g9 ultra wide mounted on it which is known for its weight. You have to fiddle with the back and forth rotating and listen for the click. Easy to use, looks awesome, great articulation.

OK, not great for my needs. I am trying to float a 55" flat screen on a powered table, this barely holds the TV up and not really high enough to use. It's not much better than the stock leg stands that came with the TV. The unit itself is nice and heavy duty so I am going to keep it. I think it is much more appropriate for a 49" curved monitor, so when my 55" flat screen dies... It would be useless for a 60" unless it hangs over the edge of the desk. My 55" is older, newer TVs weigh less. It's articulation is not designed for frequent changes, don't think of this like a dentist light. I bought this because it has the longest extension that I could find for a 55" flat screen. Only minor issue was the lock screw for rotating the display was missing. I am waiting for tech support to mail a replacement. Would I buy it again, yes. But not for anything larger than a 49" on a desk. That's why I am keeping it. 5 stars would have required it to articulate and lock easier.
Very happy with this Monitor arm. looks amazing with the LED and super easy to assemble.

Remember that part of terminator 2 where you see the terminators arm? Ok well imagine that thing holding your monitor. This thing is strong and HEAVY. You can feel how strong it is. Had no problem hooking it up, and it’s very adjustable. Totally worth it.
Excellent product. Easy to setup and works like a charm!
